channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE suspende site que dava criptomoeda em troca de propaganda de Flávio
item.description: The TSE suspended the 'Brasil 22 Token' website that distributed cryptocurrencies in exchange for supportive posts about Flávio Bolsonaro. The decision was made following reports of irregularities in the electoral campaign, indicating potential abuse of economic power to influence voters.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acusa Lula de receber propina de Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula of receiving bribes from Vorcaro, but the PT campaign rejected the accusation. The controversy involves an audio attributed to the former banker, who allegedly funded a documentary about Lula illicitly. The PGR archived the investigation for lack of evidence.

item.title: Gabi Guimarães, do vôlei, apoia reeleição de Lula: "Não podemos retroceder"
item.description: Volleyball player Gabi Guimarães endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for re-election in the 2026 Brazilian elections' second round, emphasizing the need to preserve democracy, diversity, and minority rights. Through a social media video, she expressed pride in representing Brazil and stated the country cannot afford to regress on democratic and social values.

item.title: Fachin defende reforma do Judiciário sem enfraquecer magistratura
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, defended the modernization of the Judiciary without weakening the magistracy, emphasizing the importance of involving judges in the reform and preserving their constitutional guarantees. He stressed that the independence of magistrates is a guarantee for society and that reform must be done with the Judiciary, not against it. Fachin also announced the creation of a study group to propose improvements to the justice system, with a deadline in November.

item.title: Carlos Jordy: ‘Davi Alcolumbre foi um péssimo presidente do Senado’
item.description: Elected senator Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ) criticized Davi Alcolumbre, claiming he was a poor Senate president for failing to defend the National Congress against the STF. He endorsed Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) as his preferred candidate for the Senate presidency, stressing the need for the Legislative branch to regain independence. The dispute also involves the non-installation of the Banco Master CPI, which Jordy supports.

item.title: TSE manda derrubar site que oferecia criptomoedas por posts pró-Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian Superior Electoral Court ordered the removal of the Brasil 22 Token website, which offered cryptocurrencies in exchange for pro-Flávio Bolsonaro posts. The decision was based on suspected irregular electoral advertising and breach of campaign regulations.

item.title: Datafolha: viagem, saúde, desinteresse e trabalho são os principais motivos do eleitor para não votar no 1º turno
item.description: Datafolha poll shows record voter absenteeism in 2026 at 21%, with travel, health, and disinterest as top reasons. Flavio Bolsonaro leads the 2nd round with 49% against Lula's 45%, while 43% expect life to remain the same if Lula wins, and 36% believe it will improve under Flavio.

item.title: TSE suspende site que oferece criptomoeda a quem divulgar conteúdo que defende voto em Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE suspended the 'Brasil 22 Token' website after investigating the offer of cryptocurrencies to individuals spreading pro-FlaRou Bolsnoaro political content, deeming the scheme a mechanism of economic advantage tied to electoral campaigns. The action was filed by Lula's coalition and points to possible abuse of economic power and misuse of communication. Posts involved Ugandan children and mentioned Flavio Bolsonaro, Nikolaus Ferreira, and Pablo Marcal.

item.title: Toffoli nega ao PL acesso a documentos sobre jantar de Lula com empresários
item.description: Minister Dias Toffoli denied the PL access to documents about a dinner between Lula and businessmen, considering it part of electoral dynamics and protected by constitutional freedoms. The court ruled the party provided no concrete evidence of irregularities.

item.title: Vorcaro diz ter pago R$ 30 milhões por fora ao filme do Lula
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, claims to the PGR that he paid 30 million off-the-books to the Lula Institute to fund Oliver Stone's documentary about Lula. According to magazine Veja, the money would have been a quid pro quo for Banco Master's entry into state pension funds.

item.title: Lula tenta recuperar votos com viagens a SP e Rio na próxima semana
item.description: Lula travels to Sao Paulo and Rio to recover votes in the Southeast, with events for truckers and healthcare workers, plus an interview with TV Globo. The campaign aims to offset the vote loss in 2026 compared to 2022.

item.title: Brasileirão: distância entre 2° e 3° é maior do que entre candidatos ao Z4
item.description: After round 29 of the Brazilian Championship, the top of the table remains tightly contested, with Palmeiras leading at 60 points while Flamengo (51) and Fluminense (51) apply pressure. In the relegation zone, Internacional leads the relegation zone with 30 points, and six teams are within two wins of the drop. The direct clashes in round 30 are expected to produce key outcomes at both ends of the table.

item.title: Flávio propõe superministério social com Bolsa Família e 'nova mentalidade'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced on the premiere of his TV show the creation of a Ministry of Prosperity, a social super-ministry combining Bolsa Família with a push for a 'new mindset'. The proposal, disclosed on September 9, positions the former senator as a leading figure in social affairs heading into the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro já consta em banco de mandados de prisão abertos
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) has a definitive arrest warrant issued by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for conviction of coercion, sentenced to 4 years and 2 months of imprisonment. The arrest order was forwarded to the Federal Police for execution, including passport cancellation and analysis of loss of public office. Since February 2025, Bolsonaro has been living abroad with a U.S. green card, claiming to escape political persecution.

item.title: Crianças de Uganda se desculpam por vídeo com referência a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Children from the Ugandan dance group Hypers Kids Africa apologized on Instagram after promoting a cryptocurrency platform linked to Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, sparking controversy in Brazil. The platform offered tokens to users who supported the senator's candidacy, but the team claimed no payment was received and deleted the videos to avoid political involvement. The incident was criticized for indirectly involving international support for Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Estudantes fazem atos pelo país em apoio a Lula
item.description: Students from 13 states and the Federal District held protests in support of Lula, emphasizing public education, democracy, and human rights. The National Union of Students (UNE) led the demonstrations, with actions in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Tocantins. Supporters stressed the importance of not regressing on social and political rights.

item.title: Cleitinho diz que Flávio se comprometeu a renegociar dívida de MG com a União caso seja eleito
item.description: Elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro committed to renegotiating the state's R$200 billion debt with the federal government if elected president. The proposal includes redirecting debt payment funds toward infrastructure and public security projects in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Alcolumbre pauta votação do fim da escala 6 X 1 para 14 de outubro
item.description: The Senate will hold the first vote on the PEC ending the 6 X 1 work schedule on October 14, requiring support from 49 senators in two rounds. The legislative process faces scheduling challenges for President Lula's government ahead of the 2026 elections. The proposal establishes a 40-hour weekly work schedule without salary reduction.

item.title: Bolsonaro apresentou quadro de taquicardia antes do 1º turno, diz boletim
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro experienced tachycardia and dyspnea on the eve of the 2026 election's first round, according to a medical report. Despite the episode, he is stable but experiencing medication side effects. Bolsonaro has been under house arrest since March 2026 for humanitarian reasons.

item.title: O STF não resolveu. Agora, o Congresso terá a palavra
item.description: The STF did not take a definitive stance on the investigation of a justice, leaving the matter to Congress. With the right wing nearing a majority in the Senate, the parliamentary landscape may influence decisions regarding ministerial oversight.

item.title: Datafolha: eleitores escolheram voto para governador, senador e deputados mais cedo
item.description: A Datafolha survey from 2026 indicates that more voters are deciding their choices for governor, senator, and deputies earlier than in the 2022 elections. Most respondents selected their candidates at least one month before Election Day, with fewer voters making last-minute decisions.

item.title: Flávio nega intenção de acabar com o Bolsa Família
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a candidate from the PL party, denied on Friday, 9th, any intention to cut the Bolsa Família program, labeling the claims as 'lies'. Following a meeting with Fluminense politicians, the senator rejected circulating rumors about his future administration.

item.title: Entidades pedem suspensão de criptomoeda que paga por posts pelo voto 22
item.description: Four civil society organizations requested an investigation into the 'Brasil 22 Token' (B22) platform, a cryptocurrency that pays for posts based on received votes. A formal complaint was filed with the Electoral Prosecutor's Office on September 9, 2026.

item.title: É #FAKE que Lula disse 'mulher é que nem milho'
item.description: A digitally altered image mimics a g1 article titled 'Woman is like corn, born hairy and can eat right away,' falsely attributing it to President Lula. Investigation confirmed the content is fabricated with no official record of such a statement. The photo used in the fake is from 2026 and does not match the false publication date.

item.title: Alckmin critica proposta de jornada flexível de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's flexible work schedule proposal, comparing it to a 'reserve squad' and warning workers might earn less than minimum wage. The proposal has sparked debates on labor regulation amid the 2026 election context.

item.title: Fachin nega acesso de Fux ao Inquérito das Fake News e indica que o caso será arquivado
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin denied Minister Luiz Fux's request for access to the Fake News investigation, stating the case will be archived after completing ongoing inquiries. Fux had sought full access to procedures against Jair Bolsonaro, but Fachin ruled that access will only be granted after the definitive archiving of the investigation, which involves 108 investigative procedures.

item.title: Leia os posts controversos postados por Ana Elisa, aliada de Lula
item.description: Elected federal deputy Ana Elisa (PT-MG), aged 21, addressed controversial posts shared on her X profile, acknowledging they were genuine but claimed they were taken out of context and apologized to those offended. She denied ever supporting the closure of churches and announced a forensic analysis to verify the authenticity of images shared by deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG). Her digital activism gained prominence after the first round of the 2026 elections, when she joined Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) campaign to mobilize young elected officials.

item.title: A 1ª pesquisa Palver sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: The first Palver poll of the 2026 runoff election shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 47.03% against Lula's 45.16%, with a margin of error of three percentage points. The survey interviewed 5,000 people online between Saturday and Wednesday, to be released next Thursday.

item.title: Datafolha: Em 2026, eleitor decidiu mais cedo voto para governador, senador e deputados
item.description: Datafolha research shows that Brazilian voters decided earlier on their votes for governor, senator, and deputy in 2026, with an increase in choices made at least one month before the elections. This early voting pattern indicates greater voter engagement and planning for the upcoming general elections.

item.title: AGU vai pedir direito de resposta e retificações de informações de que ligam Vorcaro a Lula
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office (AGU) requested the right of reply and correction of information published by Veja magazine, linking former banker Daniel Vorcaro to negotiations with people close to Lula regarding documentary funding and an alleged scheme of undue benefits in pension funds. The PGR and PF stated that Vorcaro did not give testimony or submit documents as described in the report. The AGU bases its request on Law 13.188/2015, emphasizing its commitment to press freedom and the integrity of the democratic process.

item.title: De PCO a Bolsonaro: saiba quem é alvo do inquérito das fake news que Fachin disse que vai arquivar
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin is reviewing the closure of the fake news inquiry, opened in 2019 to investigate attacks on ministers and allies of Bolsonaro. The case expanded over time, including figures like PCO, Allan do Santos, and Sara Winter. Fachin took over the inquiry following the crisis involving Moraes and Mendonça in the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: Datafolha: 43% esperam que vida fique igual se Lula ganhar; eleitorado se divide sobre eventual governo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 43% of voters expect life to remain the same if Lula wins, while 36% believe it will improve and 35% that it will worsen under a Flávio Bolsonaro government. The poll, conducted with 2,520 respondents, reveals a divided electorate regarding potential government scenarios. Most voters (78%) consider it very important for candidates to participate in debates.

item.title: Datafolha: 43% acham que vida seguirá igual com Lula; eleitor se divide sobre como ficará com Flávio
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 43% of voters believe life will remain the same with Lula's reelection (PT), surpassing those expecting improvements or declines. With Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), perceptions are more divided, with more respondents anticipating better or worse outcomes than stability.

item.title: Vorcaro diz em áudio que ‘colocou’ dinheiro em filme de Lula; PF e PGR negam que esteja em delação
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcara claimed in an audio recording that he funded a documentary about President Lula, but the Brazilian Attorney General's Office (PGR) denied that this information is part of the plea bargain agreement. Vorcara, detained since March, had two plea bargain proposals rejected by investigators.

item.title: Calor: 7 dúvidas sobre o impacto da alta temperatura na saúde
item.description: Rising temperatures and the 2026 super El Niño worry Brazilians about health risks like heatwaves and dehydration. The content addresses seven questions about how extreme heat impacts physical and mental well-being.

item.title: As ações que mais subiram na semana seguinte ao primeiro turno das eleições
item.description: Following the first round of the presidential election, Brazilian stocks surged, with Lojas Quero-Quero leading gains (+89.61%). The Ibovespa reached a record high of 209,017 points, driven by post-election optimism and Flávio Bolsonaro’s lead in the first Datafolha poll of the second round.

item.title: Bilenky: Reportagem da Veja vem com alta carga de intenção eleitoral
item.description: Thais Bilenky analyzed the Veja report on a purported audio of Daniel Vorcaro, highlighting its high electoral intent. The columnist discussed how this content may influence the Brazilian political scenario.

item.title: AGU pede direito de resposta à Veja por reportagem sobre Lula
item.description: The AGU requested responding rights to Veja magazine after a report mentioned alleged funding for a documentary about Lula through Daniel Vorcaro's plea deal. The agency stated it seeks to clarify information published in the article.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vai processar revista Veja e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Lula's campaign announced a lawsuit against Veja magazine and Daniel Vorcaro following a publication accusing the president of receiving kickbacks for financing a documentary. Camilo Santana described the report as a farce and highlighted lack of evidence, while the PGR and PF say Vorcaro did not give testimony with the statements released.

item.title: Grupo Lide, de Doria, fará almoço para Flávio Bolsonaro com 400 empresários a 6 dias da eleição
item.description: The Lide Group, led by João Doria, hosts a lunch for Flávio Bolsonaro with 400 business leaders at the W Hotel in São Paulo, six days before the election. The event brings together entrepreneurs and politicians to discuss the economy and government agenda.

item.title: Renan critica pressão para apoiar Flávio: “Temos dignidade”
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate defeated in the first round, criticized the pressure to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, stating he would not accept humiliation of followers and rejecting the 'herd effect'. He is the only major defeated candidate who has not yet endorsed Flávio, while Zema, Caiado, and Cury already did. Flávio and Lula face each other in the second round on October 25.

item.title: Brasileirão: Cruzeiro assume a liderança do returno; Corinthians é o último
item.description: After the 29th round of the Brazilian Championship, Cruzeiro leads the second half with 21 points, while Corinthians sits at the bottom with only five points. Cruzeiro won seven games and maintains a positive goal difference, overtaking teams like Flamengo and Santos. Corinthians, with seven consecutive losses, fired coach Fernando Diniz.

item.title: Gabriela Prioli faz balanço da política e revela voto: "Vocês já sabem"
item.description: Gabriela Prioli voiced support for Lula's policies, emphasizing the need to fight hunger and expand social rights like healthcare, education, and housing. She defended religious freedom and stressed the importance of state presence in supporting vulnerable populations.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro não reconhece autenticidade de áudio sobre filme de Lula
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense team denied the authenticity of an audio allegedly linking the former banker to a R$5 million funding for a documentary about Lula. Lawyers stated they do not recognize the origin or integrity of the material, released as part of plea bargain negotiations. The case involves figures tied to corruption investigations and upcoming elections.

item.title: PL cria ‘Tropa do Flávio’, canal idealizado por Gayer, para revidar ‘Exército do Lula’ de Janones
item.description: The PL created the 'Tropa do Flávio' WhatsApp channel to counter André Janones' 'Exército do Lula', reaching 870,000 followers in three days. Led by Gustavo Gayer with content from Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal, the initiative aims to surpass the rival channel that already has 3 million participants.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro reage à possibilidade de pedido de extradição pela PF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro reacted to the possibility of the Federal Police requesting his extradition after the Supreme Federal Court ordered the beginning of his sentence for coercion. The former federal deputy, who was abroad, now faces a new judicial phase that may impact his political life. The situation generates repercussions in the Brazilian political scenario.

item.title: Deputada eleita Ana Elisa virou grande tiro no pé da campanha de Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Elected federal deputy Ana Elisa became a key figure in Lula's campaign for the second round, but old posts on X (formerly Twitter) about taxing evangelical churches triggered backlash and threats, prompting her exit from social media. The PT campaign was frustrated by the negative reaction among evangelical voters, a group traditionally aligned with the PL. Despite this, Ana Elisa acknowledged some old posts and apologized, noting her views at 21 differ from those she expressed at 17.

item.title: PGR e PF: Vorcaro não depôs sobre financiamento de filme sobre Lula
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office and Federal Police denied that Daniel Vorcaro gave testimony matching the content reported by the magazine Veja regarding the financing of a film about Lula. According to the institutions, there was no oral testimony or submission of documents, and the immunity agreements proposed by the defense were rejected for not meeting legal requirements.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai manter Bolsa Família e Farmácia Popular
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will maintain Bolsa Família and Farmácia Popular, arguing the former should target the poorest while including training programs. He promised home delivery of medications and denied disinformation about privatizing Petrobras or dismantling social programs.

item.title: Aposta de Lula nas redes, deputada mais votada do PT vira dor de cabeça por postagens antigas
item.description: After the first round, Lula's campaign bet on Ana Elisa Santos, the most voted PT candidate, to attract young voters on social media, but her old controversial posts resurfaced and harmed the campaign. Criticism of whites, support for social media censorship, and attacks on the right were repurposed by the opposition. Lula admitted the campaign is less organized than previous ones.
